$comment: Failures of the enforced rules in src/checks.mjs that exist today, so CI stays green while the
rules are added. scripts/checks.test.mjs fails on any enforced failure missing from this list, on
any entry here that now passes, on any entry whose id no longer exists, and on any entry whose
measured value has moved by more than `tolerance`. The file cannot go stale in either direction.
Stage 2 changes the token values and empties this list. Nothing here is a reported-only
measurement: those are in dist/verify.json and never fail a test.
